
```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pyvista as pv

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable

from majordome import MajordomePlot, plot_xy
from numpy.typing import NDArray
```


```{python}
root_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
data_path = root_path / "reference/SandiaPropaneJet/SANDC3H8.JET"
data_prof = data_path / "vel/velstat"
```

```{python}
def read_profile(
        prof: Path,
        names: list[str] | None = None
    ) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """ Read a velocity profile from a text file. """
    df = pd.read_csv(
        prof,
        delimiter = r"\s+",
        header    = None,
        comment   = "C",
        names     = names
    )
    return df

def axial_velocity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> NDArray[np.float64]:
    return df["U mean"].to_numpy()

def radial_velocity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> NDArray[np.float64]:
    return df["V mean"].to_numpy()

def velocity_magnitude(df: pd.DataFrame) -> NDArray[np.float64]:
    return np.sqrt(df["U mean"]**2 + df["V mean"]**2).to_numpy()

def plot_velocity_dataset(
        root_dir: Path,
        regex: str,
        func: Callable[[pd.DataFrame], NDArray[np.float64]],
    ) -> MajordomePlot:
    names = ["x/D", "y/D", "U mean", "V mean", "Urms", "Vrms", "UV"]
    p = plot_xy()

    colors = ["k", "r", "g", "b"]
    lines = ["-", "--"]

    i_color = 0

    for i, f in enumerate(sorted(root_dir.glob(regex))):
        if f.stem.startswith("paxv"):
            continue

        df = read_profile(f, names=names)

        c = colors[i_color]
        l = lines[int(i % 2 != 0)]

        x = df["y/D"]
        y = func(df)

        p.add_curve(x, y, color=c, ls=l, label=f"{f.stem}")

        if i % 2 != 0:
            i_color += 1
            i_color = min(i_color, len(colors) - 1)

    p.xlabel("y/D")
    p.ylabel("Velocity (m/s)")
    p.legend(loc=1, fontsize=8)
    return p
```

```{python}
p = plot_velocity_dataset(
    root_dir = data_prof,
    regex    = r"p*v.*.txt",
    func     = axial_velocity
)
p.xlim(-6, 6)
```

```{python}
p = plot_velocity_dataset(
    root_dir = data_prof,
    regex    = r"p*v.*.txt",
    func     = radial_velocity
)
p.xlim(-6, 6)
```


```{python}
reader = pv.POpenFOAMReader(root_path / "model/case.foam")
reader.case_type = "decomposed"

reader.enable_all_cell_arrays()
reader.enable_all_point_arrays()

case_time = reader.time_values[-1]
reader.set_active_time_value(case_time)
```


```{python}
# case_time
mesh = reader.read()
internal = mesh["internalMesh"]

```

```{python}
yz_slice = internal.slice(normal="x", origin=(0, 0, 0.0))

# Plot the slice colored by a specific field (e.g., Temperature or Velocity magnitude)
plotter = pv.Plotter()
plotter.add_mesh(yz_slice, scalars="T", cmap="viridis", show_edges=False)
plotter.show_bounds()
plotter.camera_position = "yz"
plotter.show()
```
